payload.title: Pin the timezone and DST test matrix
payload.description:
Pin resolveWindow with table-driven tests over an injected now: UTC; America/Los_Angeles including the 2026-03-08 spring-forward and 2026-11-01 fall-back dates; Asia/Tokyo; Australia/Lord_Howe (30-minute offset); day-start variants 00:00, 04:00, 23:30; boundary inclusion (start inclusive, end exclusive); a rolling 24h window crossing a DST change; per-source timestamp parsing feeding the window filter.

Done when: the full matrix passes in Jest and a future refactor of the internals cannot change observable window behavior.
